liebermann.notes: Only ff. 1–12 are parchment, in one hand of c. 1325 (the rest is paper without legal content): ff. 1–7v Cons Cn, ff. 7v–12v ECf; the heading calls Cons 'Leges Edwardi' and treats both works as one.
